column3: MT 10:2. “On the sealed documents” is rendered “on the sealed document”; NASB supplies “the names of.”
MT 10:29. “Every one who knows, who understands” is rendered “all those who had knowledge and understanding.”

MT 10:30. “Holding on” is rendered “are joining with,” and “going in a curse and in an oath” as “are taking on themselves a curse and an oath.” “By the hand of” is rendered “through,” and “our lords” as “our Lord.”
